scenes.title: Find a target in a measured image
scenes.observation: The automatic finder returns no candidates, even though bright spots are visible.
scenes.response: Inspect the scan and zoom into a promising area.
scenes.evidence: A tool's empty candidate list does not settle what is on the surface.

scenes.title: Establish a reference before moving
scenes.observation: The closer scan resolves five spots. Astra identifies an isolated atom.
scenes.response: Measure its position and record the nearby atoms before requesting a move.
scenes.evidence: The final check must cover the neighbours as well as the selected atom.

scenes.title: The first move falls well short
scenes.observation: A new scan shows only about 0.67 nm of the requested 4 nm move.
scenes.response: Use the newly measured position to plan another attempt.
scenes.evidence: Tool summary: moved; rescan not confirmed. The image reveals the shortfall.

scenes.title: Change how the atom is moved
scenes.observation: The atom stopped long before the destination. Repeating the command alone is not enough evidence.
scenes.response: Slow the motion fivefold, keep the same destination, then scan again.
scenes.evidence: Second attempt: the speed changes from 0.5 to 0.1 nm/s.

scenes.title: Closer, but still unfinished
scenes.observation: The next scan shows about 3.84 nm of movement. A small error remains.
scenes.response: Try a short correction and acquire another image.
scenes.evidence: Near the destination is not the same as a verified final position.

scenes.title: A correction makes no progress
scenes.observation: Another scan puts the atom in the same place. The third attempt has stalled.
scenes.response: Increase the interaction strength modestly while keeping the slower motion.
scenes.evidence: Post-run record: this attempt produced zero atom hops, despite the usual tool summary.

scenes.title: Adjust, then measure again
scenes.observation: The final scan places the atom at its destination after a stronger fourth attempt.
scenes.response: Compare this scan with the reference, checking the atom and all three neighbours.
scenes.evidence: The final adjustment included a backwards hop before reaching the target.

scenes.title: Verify the whole result
scenes.observation: The atom has moved about 4.04 nm. Neighbours remain in place within the image uncertainty.
scenes.response: Submit the measured results for independent verification.
scenes.evidence: 2/2 checks pass: target position and neighbour preservation, with measurement evidence.

scenes.title: Search an uneven surface
scenes.observation: The survey contains small bright spots against a strong background.
scenes.response: Take a smaller, more detailed scan to narrow the search.
scenes.evidence: The model must find a usable atom before any manipulation can begin.

scenes.title: Inspect a candidate more closely
scenes.observation: The second survey identifies a promising area for a close-up scan.
scenes.response: Inspect that area at higher resolution before trying to move an atom.
scenes.evidence: Post-run check: the chosen area really contains an isolated atom.

scenes.title: A warning interrupts the plan
scenes.observation: The analysis tool flags a possible tip change partway through this scan.
scenes.response: Terra reports suspected instability and calls a recovery routine, capped at three attempts.
scenes.evidence: Post-run audit: no tip change occurred in this scan. The warning was a false alarm.

scenes.title: Check the recovery baseline
scenes.observation: The routine acquires a baseline image before applying a pulse.
scenes.response: The MAST routine begins its bounded sequence of conditioning pulses and checks.
scenes.evidence: The baseline quality score was not retained. The three later scores are recorded.

scenes.title: First recovery attempt
scenes.observation: After one pulse and a fresh scan, the tool reports zero quality.
scenes.response: The recovery routine proceeds to its second allowed attempt.
scenes.evidence: This is tool-reported quality, not a direct measurement of tip health.

scenes.title: Second recovery attempt
scenes.observation: A second pulse and scan do not improve the reported score.
scenes.response: The routine uses its final allowed recovery attempt.
scenes.evidence: The model is now trying to restore confidence in a measurement before acting on it.

scenes.title: Third recovery attempt
scenes.observation: The third pulse is followed by another scan. The score remains below the requested threshold.
scenes.response: The routine returns without establishing successful recovery.
scenes.evidence: All seven scans were saved. The quality metric could return zero on these images without proving a bad tip.

scenes.title: Stop without claiming success
scenes.observation: After three recovery attempts, the measurement remains unverified.
scenes.response: Terra stops. It reports no completed atom movement and submits no success claim.
scenes.evidence: 0/2 checks. Post-run audit exposes a false alarm and a limitation of the MAST quality metric.
